title: Owner drags a work order card to another technician and then to Unassigned on Board View
custom_preconds:
Signed in as Admin, viewport at least 1280 px wide.
Saved Work Orders view reset over the API (display List, no layout keys). Technicians A and B pinned; the Line technicians board field on.
A work order for a unique customer, lead technician A, with three lines added in this order: one with no technician, one assigned to technician C, one assigned to A. No shifts for A on it.

custom_steps_separated.content: Open Work Orders, pick Board View, and search for the unique customer.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The card is in A's column, its Line technicians shows A then C, and the counts read A 1, B 0.

custom_steps_separated.content: Drag the card onto B's column and release.
custom_steps_separated.expected: A drop indicator shows over B; then "Lead technician updated", the card in B's column, counts A 0 and B 1, and Line technicians B then C with A gone.
The card is still in B's column, showing B then C.

custom_steps_separated.content: Drag the card onto the Unassigned column and release.
custom_steps_separated.expected: "Lead technician removed", the card in Unassigned, B's count 0, and Line technicians showing only C.
The card is still in Unassigned, showing only C.
